title: Underived tensor projection for closed pro-etale immersions with arbitrary ring coefficients
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $R$ be any sheaf of commutative rings and put $R_Z=i^{-1}R$. Use the module inverse/direct images of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed] and ordinary sheaf tensor products [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every $R_Z$-module sheaf $M$ and $R$-module sheaf $F$, the canonical projection map
$$\pi_{M,F}:(i_*M)\otimes_R F\longrightarrow i_*(M\otimes_{R_Z}i^{-1}F)$$
is an isomorphism, natural in both inputs. Here $\pi_{M,F}$ is the $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$-adjunct of the map
$$i^{-1}((i_*M)\otimes_R F)\cong i^{-1}i_*M\otimes_{R_Z}i^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_M\otimes1}M\otimes_{R_Z}i^{-1}F,$$
where the first arrow is the ordinary inverse-image tensor comparison of [lem-pur-proetale-inverse-image-tensor-comparison] and $\varepsilon$ is the adjunction counit. If $R\to B$ is a morphism of commutative ring sheaves and $F=B$, this is an isomorphism of $B$-module sheaves, using the action on the $B$ tensor factor and the direct-image action through $B\to i_*i^{-1}B$. No flatness, finite presentation or constructibility assumption is imposed.
